description: This file is an implementation of the ManufacturerService interface, providing business logic for managing Manufacturer entities including CRUD operations, listing by store, and adding descriptions.

classes.name: ManufacturerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing business logic for handling manufacturer entities, extending generic service capabilities and integrating search functionality.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Manufacturer entity after fetching it by ID.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a given manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists manufacturers filtered by store and optionally by language.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with products in specific categories within a store.

methods.name: addManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a manufacturer and associates it accordingly.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates a new Manufacturer or updates an existing one based on the presence of an ID.
